title: tinus storckii
intro: Tinus storckii, commonly known as St. John's Wort, is a flowering plant in the family Hypericaceae. St. John's Wort is used in herbal medicine for its antidepressant and anti-inflammatory properties, providing relief from symptoms of mild to moderate depression, anxiety, and sleep disorders. The therapeutic actions of St. John's Wort include its ability to modulate neurotransmitters and exhibit antioxidant, anti-inflammatory, and antimicrobial effects. The bioactive constituents of St. John's Wort include hyperforin, hypericin, and flavonoids, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
